name: openfad
description: Chinese-first open-source creative tools for music cover art, visualizers, and motion-cover delivery.

scripts.test: npm run test:cover && npm run test:mv && npm run test:motion && node --test scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.package:motion:win: npm run fetch:ffmpeg:win --prefix apps/motion-batch && npm run dist:win --prefix apps/motion-batch && node scripts/copy-motion-runtime.mjs --platform windows
scripts.package:motion:mac: npm run dist:mac --prefix apps/motion-batch && node scripts/copy-motion-runtime.mjs --platform macos
scripts.release:prepare: npm run package:web && npm run checksums && npm run release:manifest
